title: R3 · fuller blade, textured face
changes: Ridge cuts are intersected with the beak shrunk 1 mm per face, so the lip follows the taper. The ridges run to ~92% of the way to the point.
The outer edge is fuller (A=2.0 on the outer edge, 1.31 on the jaw edge).
The edge view is truly edge-on; the beak is symmetric.
The point has a 0.5 mm radius in plan, and concave corners get 1.2 mm fillets.
review: Ridge ends nick the face edge near the tip, and there is a possible pinhole at the 4th-5th ridge from the point. genus.py confirmed two extra through-holes where grooves met slots.
The outer edge is still ~1.5 mm lean at slots 3-5.
The shoulder step above the dot still reads square. It wants a 2-3 mm fillet or a ramp.
The beak is symmetric with a rounded nub, which matches side.png and robot.png.
